title: Two weeks of work

workstreams.name: JS Build
workstreams.summary: Replaced javascript.npm with an exact package-manager pin (npm/pnpm/yarn version + per-arch sha256), then layered on build hygiene: lints refusing dangerous .npmrc / .yarnrc.yml keys and a default .pnpmfile.cjs, NODE_ENV kept out of npm steps, no shipped npm-shrinkwrap.json, pnpm guard env on every step, and offline replay of classic yarn.lock. Closed out JS 1B Build with the phase demo ([[ECO-4709]]): a 2017 package (growl@1.10.2) built on its own toolchain. Started activating pinned Yarn Classic builds ([[mono#70353]], [[ECO-4680]]).

workstreams.name: JS Verify
workstreams.summary: Designed and landed per-genome exact Jess release pins (policy package with schema-set, floor and fault checks), shipped eco-jess r1 bundling a pinned Node 22 + npm 12 and ran Jess under it, and hardened Jess intake against hostile tarballs — no escapes across the demo's 158 hostile-tarball runs. Closed out JS 1A Verify with the phase demo ([[ECO-4705]]): genomes pinned to r0 and r1 both pass; missing or bad pins hold before any guest starts.

workstreams.name: plasmad
workstreams.summary: Picked up BLD work from Dann's GPU executor-modes and held-pools designs (reviewed and approved both design docs on Oct 7). Five draft PRs: executor-mode taint, affinity and rotation ([[BLD-1192]]); tenant registry checked at claim ([[BLD-1306]], filed); entitlement at grant ([[BLD-1191]]); qualification-only incarnations and rollouts gated on qualification sessions ([[BLD-1188]]).

workstreams.name: Mentat
workstreams.summary: Mentat's npm-layer skill selection now keys on the package manager, and Yarn Berry gets its own authoring skill ([[ECO-4606]], [[ECO-4650]]). Continued Julian's npm relocks PR as mono#67961 while Julian was out ([[ECO-4692]]); rebased onto the reworked judge, needs re-review.

other.name: Other
other.summary: mentat-wq now alerts on dead-letter arrivals rather than depth ([[ECO-4444]], superseding mono#59455); closed the on-ice pack-phase journal draft.

highlights: JS 1A Verify closed out ([[ECO-4705]]) — per-genome Jess release pins, eco-jess r1 with a bundled pinned Node, and hostile-tarball intake hardening; two genomes on two Jess releases pass through one processor.
JS 1B Build closed out ([[ECO-4709]]) — exact package-manager pins plus npm / yarn / pnpm hardening; a 2017 package builds on its own toolchain. Remaining items tracked in [[ECO-5527]].
Started plasmad GPU executor modes — five draft PRs across [[BLD-1188]], [[BLD-1191]], [[BLD-1192]] and [[BLD-1306]], after reviewing Dann's design docs.
Kept the publish path moving — on tickets I filed, Michael Smith closed the npm publish-to-serve-js trio ([[ECO-4674]], [[ECO-4918]], [[ECO-4919]]) and started [[ECO-4920]].
Covered for Julian — merged Julian's pinned-toolchains design and carried the npm relocks PR forward as mono#67961.
